'''May 2000 North Dartmouth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in North Dartmouth, MA on 13 May 2000. [[Steve Brentson]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d754">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-17-north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000d754/ north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 17 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-17-north-dartmouth-ma-5-13-2000d754/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2000
* '''Site:''' North Dartmouth, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
